key_notes: Key 1 (t=7.43s): Initial archival pose of tiger; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.

Key 3 (t=9.79s): Peak dynamic extension of tiger over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=11.03s): Follow-through and settle of tiger with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of tiger (7.43s..11.03s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
